summary: The implementation preserves short technical-valid tracks and exposes specimen-level below-2-um sensitivity fields, while focused tests cover morphology-neutral tracking and missing-plane linking. Acceptance remains conditional because the retained sensitivity artifact and tests do not directly prove end-to-end omission-of-below-2-um reconciliation for the reviewed commit.

evidence: `sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:7141-7164` defines `technical_valid` independently from morphology warnings and sets `is_biological_candidate` from technical validity.
`tests/test_saturn_v571_dual_head.py:224-250` verifies a short terminal observation can bridge one missing plane with morphology-neutral tracking.
`tests/test_saturn_v571_audit_blockers.py:200-250` verifies missing-slice accounting and no invented volume interpolation.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13633-13649` computes below-2-um counts, fractions, omitted-count sensitivity, and sensitivity morphometry per specimen.

`audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json:2-27` declares biological-specimen analysis, descriptive sensitivity, formulas, and primary-versus-upper-bound interpretation.
`audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_source_binding.json:24-46` records reconstructed and technical-valid track counts and asserts report/sensitivity replay use and count reconciliation.
`tests/test_specimen_sensitivity_artifact.py:11-44` verifies retained excluded specimens, denominator validity, count formulas, and specimen-level metadata.
`tests/test_saturn_v571_dual_head.py:224-250` tests linking and missing-plane behavior but does not assert that a below-2-um technical-valid track remains in the primary output.
`tests/test_specimen_sensitivity_artifact.py:11-44` tests generic specimen sensitivity accounting but does not construct or assert an omitted-below-2-um scenario.
The retained JSON artifact records `technical_valid_count` and width missingness, but its shown formulas do not include the below-2-um omission scenario.
`audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md:16-29` records prior passing validation at commit `6f9e73b`, not `7a4c7d13a88f441e490b330ffe5206b418633c1e`.
No full stack or fresh pytest execution was run under this read-only review.

findings.title: Direct below-2-um omission sensitivity is not independently executable from retained focused tests
findings.impact: The implementation contains the intended sensitivity fields, but software reproducibility of the specific claim is incomplete because the focused tests do not verify that removing below-2-um tracks changes specimen counts and morphometry as declared.
evidence: `tests/test_specimen_sensitivity_artifact.py:11-44` lacks a below-2-um synthetic input and expected omitted-population result.
`audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json:8-27` documents sensitivity formulas that do not explicitly include below-2-um omission.
findings.recommendation: Add a deterministic specimen-level synthetic test and retained artifact assertion covering primary count, below-2-um count, omitted count, fraction, and median morphometry before unconditional acceptance.

limitations: No full image stack or end-to-end pipeline was run.
Retained validation evidence predates the reviewed commit.
recommended_follow_up: Add and run a focused below-2-um sensitivity test at the reviewed commit.
Regenerate the retained specimen sensitivity artifact with explicit below-2-um scenario fields and commit-bound hashes.
